items.title: A weaker condition for the pushforward to preserve surjections

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a condition under which the pushforward along a morphism of sites preserves surjections: given a covering of the image of an object, a covering of the object must exist such that the associated map of representable sheaves factors through the given one (statement lines 9966-9982). The proof is a complete argument: a section of the pushforward is locally lifted along a covering of its image, producing a commutative diagram (proof lines 9985-9996); the assumption then provides a covering of the object allowing that diagram to be enlarged (proof lines 9997-10005); and the enlarged diagram exhibits the section as locally in the image, whence surjectivity (proof lines 10006-10011). The non-formal content is the enlargement of the diagram. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
